title: Renewal Slate: Scenario Lab and Pipeline Grid
summary: Working spreadsheet for QBR renewal scenario experiments. Tracks contracts, ARR, probability inputs, friction and sponsor signals, and produces a confidence-adjusted ARR for forecasting and play prioritization. Intended as a facilitator for weekly renewal studio review and handoffs to SE/AE for high-friction deals.
assumptions: Confidence-adjusted ARR uses conservative sponsor and friction multipliers; Likelihood is an input from AE/CSE consensus. AutoRenew flagged accounts get a base +10 percentage points unless manual opt-out noted. New upsell opportunities are modeled separately and excluded from base ARR column.

formulas: Confidence-Adjusted ARR (example calc) = Base ARR * (Likelihood / 100) * SponsorMultiplier * (1 - FrictionScore/20). SponsorMultiplier: map Sponsor Health 5->1.08,4->1.04,3->1.0,2->0.95,1->0.9. AutoRenew adjustment: if AutoRenew == yes then add +0.10 to Likelihood before calc unless manual opt-out in Notes.

notes: This slate is intentionally conservative — the friction multiplier penalizes deals with legal/technical blockers to avoid overforecasting. forecasting_tip: When rolling up confidence-adjusted ARR to the quarter, separately bucket accounts by friction band (1-3 low,4-6 medium,7-10 high) and apply scenario uplift of +5% for low band if product adoption trending positive (tracked in product-usage dashboard).
